exposure: age at the time of delivery
age at the time of kidney donation
women donors aged 45 years or younger at the time of kidney donation
cohort: 225 women who donated a kidney before the age of 45 and later had a pregnancy
finding: The study found no significant differences in the risk of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or other maternal or fetal complications between women who had donated a kidney and a matched group of non-donors.
mod_finding: There were no differences in primary pregnancy complication outcomes between women who had pregnancies before or after kidney donation, except for a higher proportion of cesarean sections in the post-donation group.
